shots.prompt: Night again over the small blue house, fog, the bedroom window glows, slow push-in
lines: Night two. Six nights left to bring a runaway dream home.

shots.prompt: Mira in her bedroom ties her shoes, the brass lantern on the bed glows silver, the tiny silver bell hangs on a ribbon around her neck
A pebble taps the bedroom window; outside under the street lamp the red-haired boy in a yellow raincoat waves up nervously
lines: Theo? What are you doing here?

shots.prompt: The red-haired boy under the street lamp at night whispers up toward the window
lines: You saw the singing snow too. I'm coming with you. No arguments.

shots.prompt: Mira and Theo walk together down the foggy night street, her lantern lighting the cobblestones, dream lights glowing in windows
lines: So… where exactly are we going?

shots.prompt: The grand old library doors open by themselves with golden light; Theo freezes, Mira pulls him inside by the sleeve
Reveal: Theo sees the endless archive of glowing jars for the first time, his jaw drops
Elias stands among the glowing shelves holding a candle, slightly amused, looking at the two children
lines: You brought a friend. The Archive does not usually allow guests.

shots.prompt: Close-up of Theo swallowing nervously, glancing at Mira
Elias smiles kindly and gestures to the shelves
lines: But the jars are humming for him. So… welcome, young man.

shots.prompt: Elias leads Mira and Theo down a long glowing aisle, jars brightening as they pass
lines: If you are going to help, you must know the three rules of the Archive.

shots.prompt: Elias raises one finger, serious and gentle, candlelight on his face
lines: Rule one. Never open a jar that is not yours.

shots.prompt: Mira looks down guiltily, Theo glances at her
lines: It opened by itself. I promise.

shots.prompt: Elias raises two fingers
lines: Rule two. A dream outside its jar grows weaker in daylight. And stranger.

shots.prompt: Theo in the archive, wide-eyed
Elias nods slowly, then raises three fingers
lines: Exactly like that. Rule three. Never let the Shadow catch a dream.

shots.prompt: Mira's face turns serious; she remembers the figure on the rooftop
lines: The man in the hat. I saw him on the school roof.

shots.prompt: A row of jars on a far shelf slowly dims and goes dark one by one, cold blue mist creeping
Elias looks toward the dark shelves, worried
lines: He collects lost dreams and silences them. If he catches yours, it is gone forever.

shots.prompt: Elias opens a huge ancient leather ledger on a wooden desk, golden handwriting glowing on the pages
lines: Every jar is written here. Whose dream it is, and when it was dreamed.

shots.prompt: Close-up of an old page with glowing golden lines; one line has been torn out of the page
Mira leans over the ledger, finger tracing the torn edge
lines: Someone tore it out. The name for our jar is missing.

shots.prompt: Theo looks around nervously into the dark aisles
lines: Please tell me the Shadow can't read.

shots.prompt: The tiny silver bell around Mira's neck starts to glow and ring softly by itself, silver sparkles
Mira holds up the ringing bell, eyes wide
lines: It's ringing. The dream is close!

shots.prompt: A thin silver ribbon of star-dust light zips across the far end of the aisle and disappears around a corner
Mira and Theo run down the aisle after the light, lantern swinging, jars flashing as they pass
lines: Careful! Stay where the jars are bright!

shots.prompt: They reach a dark old staircase leading down; silver light glitters at the bottom, cold mist
At the bottom of the stairs the silver ribbon of light hovers in the air, curling softly like a shy animal
lines: Hey… it's okay. I'm not going to hurt you.

shots.prompt: Mira slowly reaches out her hand; the light drifts closer and gently touches her fingertips, sparkles
Dreamlike flash: a warm blurry memory of a man's hands holding a small child's hands under a starry sky, golden haze
Mira gasps softly, tears in her eyes, confused
lines: I… I know this. I've seen this before.

shots.prompt: At the top of the staircase a tall shadow in a wide-brimmed hat appears, blocking the light, the jars beside it go dark
Theo grabs Mira's arm, terrified
The silver light startles and flies away through a crack in the stone wall, vanishing
Elias rushes in holding the candle high, its flame flaring bright gold
lines: Away from them! The children are under my protection!

shots.prompt: In the golden candlelight the shadow figure slowly dissolves into smoke and disappears
Mira stares at the crack in the wall, determined, holding the glowing bell
lines: Five nights left. And Mira was beginning to remember.
